categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Changes RPC presentation of fee rates only; mempool acceptance, policy, and data structures are untouched.
categories.rationale: The change alters RPC output formatting rather than mempool policy or fee estimation behavior.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC endpoints in src/rpc/.
categories.rationale: Exposing fee rates in sat/vB directly solves client friction and conversion rounding errors for ecosystem consumers. The PR adds an optional `sat_vb` argument to `getmempoolinfo`, `getnetworkinfo`, `estimatesmartfee`, and `estimaterawfee` without breaking existing BTC/kvB default callers.
